thread:
frank-releng: Canary opened 14:10 UTC in us-west-2. deploybot flagged a latency & error wobble on /v1/chat around 14:16. notably p95 and a small increase in 5xx. keep small fixes first?
jo-sre: can you post the deploybot alert details? want to see duration and whether auto-rollback tripped.
deploybot: DeployBot: Canary alert: latency_p95 = +95ms (threshold 70ms), requests_5xx = 0.28% (threshold 0.15%), duration = 5m. Auto-rollback = SUPPRESSED (requires human confirm for combined signals). Suggested mitigations: reduce canary slice, toggle runtime feature flag, or pin to prior model.
anya-eng: FYI new runtime patch included attention-kernel tweak + quantization tweak. local repro with the kernel change shows latency rise. kernel tweak revert drops p95 back.
frank-releng: prefer hitting the feature flag first rather than full pin. mike-ops, can you toggle the attention-kernel flag for canary nodes? keep traffic at 3% while we watch 10m.
mike-ops: on it. running: `runtime.attn.kernel_v2 = off` for nodes tagged canary-6190. will also scale canary to 3%: `trafficctl update --route chat --slice 3%`. logging action id ac9e11.
jo-sre: noted. I'll watch SLO dashboards and error logs. if p95 not below +30ms in 6m we escalate to pin. who signs off on pin?
frank-releng: I'll sign off for pin if flag toggle doesn't help. anya, stage the pin command as no-op.
anya-eng: pinned command staged: `redwood route pin --model chat-api --version v3.1.4 --reason "canary instability 6190012345"`. needs release lead confirmation to execute.
eva-cs: PSA: field noticed 1 complaint from an enterprise customer about timeouts. prepping customer note but holding until we confirm action. prefer wording: "temporary quality regression for a small subset; mitigation in progress."
jo-sre: metrics after flag toggle: p95 -> +28ms, 5xx -> 0.12% within ~80s. looks promising.
frank-releng: great. keep 10m watch. if stable, capture as "flag interaction" in release notes. if regress within watch, we execute pin + notify customers.
mike-ops: standing by to execute the pin. runbook reminders in thread: 1) `redwood route pin` will route new sessions to pinned model; in-flight sessions continue. 2) open rollback ticket with tag `rollback:canary-6190012345`.
anya-eng: will also add a short runbook entry: revert kernel in the build pipeline and cut a follow-up patch to avoid recurring toggles.
jo-sre: I'll own the post-incident blameless postmortem if we end up pinning.
frank-releng: thanks everyone. closing watch if 10m stable, else escalate. :white_check_mark:
